description: v3 baseline of the SCAR main grid (pi x scale) + linear SAR diagnostic line for the 6 binary PU classifiers (PNU runs its own tri-label config, contract §2.2). Same grid/data/seeds/timeouts/params as v2; re-run under the metric contract v2 (def1544): pu_zero_one_risk now follows each classifier's native predict() threshold instead of a fixed zero threshold on raw scores. Only elkan_noto is numerically affected (its native threshold is 0.5); the other five methods threshold at zero, so their rows must reproduce v2 exactly (consistency audit in findings). PNU is unaffected (no binary PU risk on its tri-label grid) and keeps pnu_baseline_v2. v2 config/results remain frozen history snapshots. contract v2 | elkan_noto tuning candidate 'r2_default' with overrides {}
limitations: synthetic SCAR/linear-SAR only; fixed n_features=5; label_frequency=0.5
